name: Caribbean Bush Teas
summary: Ginger tea, fever grass, coconut water and mint from island grandmothers.

remedies.name: Ginger Tea
remedies.howItHelps: Fresh ginger tea is the Caribbean go-to for an upset tummy.
steps: Strain and add a little honey.
remedies.caution: Honey is fine for big kids, never for babies under one year.

remedies.name: Fever Grass Tea
remedies.howItHelps: Lemongrass tea is drunk warm when you have a cold.
steps: Steep lemongrass stalks in hot water.

remedies.name: Jelly Coconut Water
remedies.howItHelps: Fresh young coconut water replaces salts you sweat out.
steps: Sip cool coconut water in the shade.
